2607.15550.title: SeerGuard: A Safety Framework for Mobile GUI Agents via World Model Prediction
2607.15550.paper_summary: Mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in automating complex tasks, yet they introduce critical safety risks where a single erroneous action can lead to irreversible consequences. Existing safety mechanisms are primarily reactive, lacking the ability to assess risks before execution. In this paper, we introduce SeerGuard, a consequence-aware safety framework designed to mitigate these risks through pre-execution instruction-level screening and action-level risk assessment. Specifically, the action-level assessment analyzes agent-proposed actions within current GUI states, anticipating likely outcomes to identify risks before they are executed. To enable these capabilities, we construct a unified safety-augmented world model (SAWM) via multi-task learning, integrating semantic next-state prediction with safety risk assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SeerGuard generalizes effectively across diverse mobile GUI agents. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, it increases the safety-utility score from $0.191$ to $0.596$ at $ω=0.8$ and reduces the risk-cost score from $0.347$ to $0.130$ at $α=0.8$. Further analyses on our SAWM validate the effectiveness of the instruction-level screening, alongside the capability of action risk assessment and next-state prediction.
2607.15550.paper_summary_zh: 行動圖形用戶界面 (GUI) 代理在自動化複雜任務方面展現了卓越的能力，但它們也帶來了重大的安全風險，因為一次錯誤的行動可能導致不可逆轉的後果。現有的安全機制主要是反應性的，缺乏在執行前評估風險的能力。在本文中，我們介紹了 SeerGuard，一個考慮後果的安全框架，旨在通過執行前的指令級篩選和行動級風險評估來減輕這些風險。具體而言，行動級評估分析代理提出的行動在當前 GUI 狀態下的情況，預測可能的結果以在執行前識別風險。為了實現這些功能，我們通過多任務學習構建了一個統一的安全增強世界模型 (SAWM)，將語義下一狀態預測與安全風險評估整合在一起。廣泛的實驗表明，SeerGuard 在各種行動 GUI 代理中有效地泛化。在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，它將安全效用分數從 $0.191$ 提高到 $0.596$，在 $ω=0.8$ 時將風險成本分數從 $0.347$ 降低到 $0.130$，在 $α=0.8$ 時。我們對 SAWM 的進一步分析驗證了指令級篩選的有效性，以及行動風險評估和下一狀態預測的能力。
